expl: The Suez Canal is the world’s largest artificial canal, built in Egypt across the Isthmus of Suez. In 1869, its length was 164 km, and in 2015 its total length was 193.30 km. This canal, which connects the Mediterranean Sea and the Red Sea, was opened for ship traffic in 1869. At its southern end, at the city of Suez, is Port Tewfik (Suez Port), and at its northern end is Port Said. After the canal was built, the distance between Europe and Asia reduced greatly, because before this canal, ships traveling between Europe and Asia had to go around the African continent.
The Panama Canal is a major shipping canal built by cutting through the Isthmus of Panama in Central America. It connects the Atlantic Ocean to the Pacific Ocean.

stem: Clear sky nights are cooler than cloudy sky nights due to
expl: On cloudy nights, the amount of water vapour in the atmosphere is higher than on clear nights. Water vapour absorbs the outgoing terrestrial radiation; therefore, cloudy nights feel comparatively warmer. In addition, on clear nights, due to lower water vapour in the atmosphere, terrestrial radiation easily escapes into space at night, and clear nights feel colder. In fact, the atmosphere behaves like a greenhouse.

stem: In which hemisphere, roaring forties, furious fifties and shrieking sixties are blowing?

options.label: e
options.text: None of the above/More than one of the above

expl: The Roaring Forties, Furious Fifties, and Shrieking Sixties blow in the Southern Hemisphere. These names are given on the basis of the extreme intensity of the westerlies in the Southern Hemisphere.
